groundability_report.reason: The provided evidence chunks contain direct, factual information about annual leave accrual, including the accrual rate, maximum rollover, and utilization rules. The excerpts from the 'leave_and_attendance_policy.pdf' document provide clear details on these aspects.

citations.excerpt: Annual leave entitlement: Full-time employees accrue 22 working days of paid annual leave per calendar year. Annual leave accrues monthly at the rate of 1.83 working days per completed month of active service. Maximum annual leave rollover: Up to 5 unused annual leave days may be carried forward into the subsequent calendar year. Carried-forward annual leave must be utilized before March 31 of the new calendar year or it is forfeited.
